svg.text: FitBud: the life of a coaching relationship (full product)
From the trainer's invitation to the ended relationship, with the checks the code performs (API Worker, 12 Nov 2026). One lane per person or system; numbers are the steps in order.
conflicted or rejected: shown, never silently overwritten
Invalidation: an ended relationship or archived account makes every write fail on the server first, then in the UI. Archived accounts reach only status, reactivation and sign-out.
Plan rules: published versions never change; an adjustment is a new version with an effective time, and history keeps the version used at the time.
Exceptions: never auto-resolved. A late log is shown as 'logged late' and does not close the exception. Each keeps its source signal.
Push: the payload carries routing only. Provider acceptance is recorded separately from completion; receipts are read 15 min to 24 h later.
Not in this flow: trainee food and meal-time settings, steps sync, libraries, templates, WhatsApp (built, flags off) and account deletion.
unconfirmed in code (see README sections 3 and 4)
